status.nb: 19 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 50 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Sweida.

summary.en: Syrian security forces arrested a Hezbollah-linked cell that planned to bomb the Homs oil refinery, preventing the attack. Hezbollah has denied the Syrian allegations of the plot. Israeli airstrikes hit southern Syria, causing civilian casualties. The conflict continues to generate high fatalities, with 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker arresterte en Hezbollah-tilknyttet celle som planla å bombe Homs oljeraffineri, og hindret angrepet. Hezbollah har avvist de syriske påstandene om planen. Israels luftangrep traff sørlige Syria og forårsaket sivile tap. Konflikten fortsetter å gi høye dødstall, med 2 732 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
